This freeze does not authorize inference requests. A separate explicit user authorization is required for a specific run.
Capture sends only the frozen prompt, one user text and the frozen tool schemas; oracle, labels, pair IDs and stimulus IDs are not sent.
The output of capture consists of proposals only. Replay is local and uses mock tools; no real-world operation is invoked.
